title: Project Manager Agent - Directory Contract
description: Runtime paths are resolved by platform_core.settings and mapped per deployment node; common.workspace_config remains a compatibility facade for legacy callers.

validation_rules.fix: Set PROJECT_MANAGER_BUSINESS_ROOT and PROJECT_MANAGER_WORKSPACE_DIR explicitly for this deployment node.

validation_rules.check: cloud-drive files must be readable before extraction or archive execution
